posts.title: Microwaved coffee
posts.description: When I began thinking about what it means to have a good cup of coffee, I was starting working in tech sometime in 2015. I was young, and didn’t know much, and not only about coffee. At the time the cup of coffee to me meant a semi-automatic drip machine that would grind the beans right before. posts.description: As summer was approaching, I was concerned about our plans. posts.title: Childhood dream: playing music loud
posts.description: I grew up on the outskirts of one of a major city in Ukraine. We lived in a 2 bedroom apartment, that was literally a 2 room apartment.
